items.stem: What is the news report mainly about?

choices.text: How college students can handle their psychological problems.
choices.zh: 大学生如何处理他们的心理问题。

choices.text: Why college students are more likely to have stress problems.
choices.zh: 为什么大学生更容易出现压力问题。

choices.text: Why sufficient sleep is important for college students.
choices.zh: 为什么充足的睡眠对大学生很重要。

choices.text: How college students can improve their sleep habits.
choices.zh: 大学生如何改善他们的睡眠习惯。

items.stem: What is the finding of the new study published in the journal Learning and Memory?

choices.text: It is not easy to improve one's sleep habits.
choices.zh: 改善一个人的睡眠习惯并不容易。

choices.text: It is not good for students to play video games.
choices.zh: 学生玩电子游戏不好。

choices.text: Making last-minute preparations for tests may be less effective than sleeping.
choices.zh: 临时抱佛脚准备考试可能不如睡觉有效。

choices.text: Students who are better prepared generally get higher scores in examinations.
choices.zh: 准备更充分的学生通常在考试中获得更高的分数。

items.stem: What is the Competition Commission going to investigate?

choices.text: Whether adequate investment is being made to improve airport facilities.
choices.zh: 是否正在进行充足的投资以改善机场设施。

choices.text: Whether the British Airports Authority should sell off some of its assets.
choices.zh: British Airports Authority 是否应该出售其部分资产。

choices.text: Whether the Spanish company could offer better service.
choices.zh: 这家西班牙公司是否能提供更好的服务。

choices.text: Whether more airports should be built around London.
choices.zh: 是否应该在伦敦周边建设更多机场。

items.stem: What is the root cause of the poor service at British airports according to the British Airports Authority?

choices.text: Poor ownership structure.
choices.zh: 所有权结构不良。

choices.text: Inefficient management.
choices.zh: 管理效率低下。

choices.text: Lack of innovation and competition.
choices.zh: 缺乏创新和竞争。

choices.text: Lack of runway and terminal capacity.
choices.zh: 缺乏跑道和航站楼容量。

items.stem: What do tobacco companies have to do under the law in Massachusetts?

choices.text: Study the effects of nicotine on young smokers.
choices.zh: 研究尼古丁对年轻吸烟者的影响。

choices.text: Set a limit to the production of their cigarettes.
choices.zh: 对其卷烟的产量设定限制。

choices.text: Take steps to reduce nicotine in their products.
choices.zh: 采取措施减少其产品中的尼古丁。

choices.text: Report the nicotine content of their cigarettes.
choices.zh: 报告其卷烟的尼古丁含量。

items.stem: What do we learn from the study by the Department of Public Health in Boston?

choices.text: The biggest increase in nicotine content tended to be in brands young smokers like.
choices.zh: 尼古丁含量增幅最大的往往是年轻吸烟者喜欢的品牌。

choices.text: Brands which contain higher nicotine content were found to be much more popular.
choices.zh: 尼古丁含量较高的品牌被发现更受欢迎得多。

choices.text: Tobacco companies refused to discuss the detailed nicotine content of their products.
choices.zh: 烟草公司拒绝讨论其产品的详细尼古丁含量。

choices.text: Big tobacco companies were frank with their customers about the hazards of smoking.
choices.zh: 大型烟草公司对其客户坦率说明吸烟的危害。

items.stem: What do we learn from the news report about the big tobacco companies?

choices.text: They will pay more attention to the quality of their products.
choices.zh: 它们将更加重视其产品的质量。

choices.text: They were not prepared to comment on the cigarette study.
choices.zh: 它们未准备好对卷烟研究发表评论。

choices.text: They promised to reduce the nicotine content in cigarettes.
choices.zh: 它们承诺减少卷烟中的尼古丁含量。

choices.text: They have not fully realized the harmful effect of nicotine.
choices.zh: 它们尚未充分认识到尼古丁的有害影响。

items.stem: Where does the woman live right now?

choices.text: Holland.
choices.zh: 荷兰。

choices.text: Indonesia.
choices.zh: 印度尼西亚。

choices.text: England.
choices.zh: 英格兰。

choices.text: Sweden.
choices.zh: 瑞典。

items.stem: What does the woman say is the real challenge?

choices.text: Talking with her boyfriend in Dutch.
choices.zh: 用荷兰语与她的男朋友交谈。

choices.text: Getting a coach who can offer real help.
choices.zh: 找到一位能提供真正帮助的教练。

choices.text: Acquiring the necessary ability to socialize.
choices.zh: 获得必要的社交能力。

choices.text: Learning a language where it is not spoken.
choices.zh: 在不使用某种语言的地方学习该语言。

items.stem: What does the woman suggest doing to learn to speak a foreign language?

choices.text: Practicing reading aloud as often as possible.
choices.zh: 尽可能经常地练习朗读。

choices.text: Listening to language programs on the radio.
choices.zh: 收听广播中的语言节目。

choices.text: Trying to speak it as much as one can.
choices.zh: 尽可能多地尝试说这门语言。

choices.text: Making friends with native speakers.
choices.zh: 与母语者交朋友。

items.stem: What does the woman say about the Study Circles in Sweden?

choices.text: It provides opportunities for language practice.
choices.zh: 它提供语言练习的机会。

choices.text: It trains young people's leadership abilities.
choices.zh: 它培训年轻人的领导能力。

choices.text: It offers various courses with credit points.
choices.zh: 它提供带学分的各种课程。

choices.text: It creates an environment for socializing.
choices.zh: 它创造了一个社交环境。

items.stem: What are the speakers mainly talking about?

choices.text: A sense of freedom driving gives.
choices.zh: 驾驶带来的自由感。

choices.text: Rules and regulations for driving.
choices.zh: 驾驶的规则和法规。

choices.text: The role policemen play in traffic safety.
choices.zh: 警察在交通安全中发挥的作用。

choices.text: The impact of engine design on road safety.
choices.zh: 发动机设计对道路安全的影响。

items.stem: What does the woman think car manufacturers could do?

choices.text: Make cars with automatic control.
choices.zh: 制造具有自动控制功能的汽车。

choices.text: Make cars with higher standards.
choices.zh: 制造标准更高的汽车。

choices.text: Make cars that are less powerful.
choices.zh: 制造动力较小的汽车。

choices.text: Make cars that have better brakes.
choices.zh: 制造刹车性能更好的汽车。

items.stem: What can we learn about people driving in Germany?

choices.text: They follow traffic rules closely.
choices.zh: 他们严格遵守交通规则。

choices.text: They keep within speed limits.
choices.zh: 他们遵守限速规定。

choices.text: They like to go at high speed.
choices.zh: 他们喜欢高速行驶。

choices.text: They tend to drive responsibly.
choices.zh: 他们倾向于负责任地驾驶。

items.stem: What does the woman think of the police fining drivers?

choices.text: It is a bad idea.
choices.zh: 这是个坏主意。

choices.text: It is as effective as speed bumps.
choices.zh: 它和减速带一样有效。

choices.text: It is not useful.
choices.zh: 它没有用处。

choices.text: It should be combined with education.
choices.zh: 它应该与教育相结合。

items.stem: What happened when Sam Azar swiped his credit card to pay for his purchase?

choices.text: The card got damaged.
choices.zh: 卡片损坏了。

choices.text: The card was found invalid.
choices.zh: 卡片被认定无效。

choices.text: The card reader broke down unexpectedly.
choices.zh: 读卡器意外发生故障。

choices.text: The card reader failed to do the scanning.
choices.zh: 读卡器无法进行扫描。

items.stem: How did Sam Azar manage to complete the sale?

choices.text: By seeking help from the card reader maker Verifone.
choices.zh: 通过向读卡器制造商Verifone寻求帮助。

choices.text: By covering the credit card with a layer of plastic.
choices.zh: 通过用一层塑料覆盖信用卡。

choices.text: By calling the credit card company for confirmation.
choices.zh: 通过致电信用卡公司进行确认。

choices.text: By typing the credit card number into the cash register.
choices.zh: 通过将信用卡号码输入收银机。

items.stem: What is today's shaky economy likely to do?

choices.text: Produce many low-tech fixes for high-tech failures.
choices.zh: 为高科技故障产生许多低技术解决方法。

choices.text: Give birth to many new technological inventions.
choices.zh: 催生许多新的技术发明。

choices.text: Change the lifestyle of many Americans.
choices.zh: 改变许多美国人的生活方式。

choices.text: Affect the sales of high-tech appliances.
choices.zh: 影响高科技产品的销售。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about the procedures for assigning academic advisers?

choices.text: They vary among different departments.
choices.zh: 它们在不同院系之间各不相同。

choices.text: They leave much room for improvement.
choices.zh: 它们还有很大的改进空间。

choices.text: They are determined by the advising board.
choices.zh: 它们由指导委员会决定。

choices.text: They are set by the dean of the graduate school.
choices.zh: 它们由研究生院院长制定。

items.stem: How can new graduate students learn who their advisers are?

choices.text: By consulting the examining committee.
choices.zh: 通过咨询考试委员会。

choices.text: By reading the Bulletin of Information.
choices.zh: 通过阅读信息公告。

choices.text: By visiting the university's website.
choices.zh: 通过访问大学网站。

choices.text: By contacting the departmental office.
choices.zh: 通过联系院系办公室。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about graduation requirements?

choices.text: They are harder to meet than those for undergraduates.
choices.zh: 它们比本科生的要求更难达到。

choices.text: They specify the number of credits students must earn.
choices.zh: 它们明确规定了学生必须获得的学分数量。

choices.text: They have to be approved by the examining committee.
choices.zh: 它们必须经过考试委员会批准。

choices.text: They are the same among various divisions of the university.
choices.zh: 它们在大学的各个学部之间都是相同的。

items.stem: Who does Jody Hubbard primarily speak to?

choices.text: Ph. D. candidates in dieting.
choices.zh: 节食方面的博士研究生。

choices.text: Students majoring in nutrition.
choices.zh: 主修营养学的学生。

choices.text: Students in health classes.
choices.zh: 健康课上的学生。

choices.text: Middle and high school teachers.
choices.zh: 初中和高中教师。

items.stem: What is Jody Hubbard's biggest concern about American culture?

choices.text: Its overemphasis on thinness.
choices.zh: 过分强调瘦。

choices.text: Its changing criteria for beauty.
choices.zh: 不断变化的美的标准。

choices.text: Its mistaken conception of nutrition.
choices.zh: 对营养的错误观念。

choices.text: Its overestimate of the effect of dieting.
choices.zh: 高估了节食的效果。

items.stem: Why does Jody Hubbard show pictures of beautiful women to her audiences?

choices.text: To demonstrate the magic effect of dieting on women.
choices.zh: 展示节食对女性的神奇效果。

choices.text: To explain how computer images can be misleading.
choices.zh: 解释计算机图像如何具有误导性。

choices.text: To prove that technology has impacted our culture.
choices.zh: 证明技术已经影响了我们的文化。

choices.text: To illustrate her point that beauty is but skin deep.
choices.zh: 说明她的观点:美只是表面的。

items.stem: What is Jody Hubbard's main purpose in giving her speeches?

choices.text: To help students rid themselves of bad living habits.
choices.zh: 帮助学生摆脱不良生活习惯。

choices.text: To establish an emotional connection with students.
choices.zh: 与学生建立情感联系。

choices.text: To promote her own concept of beauty.
choices.zh: 推广她自己的美的观念。

choices.text: To persuade girls to stop dieting.
choices.zh: 说服女孩停止节食。
